levels.surface: الحارث بن محمد بن النعمان الاحول صاحب الطاق

notes: «أخيه علي» is read as the name alone (rule 7); occurrence 2 because the first «علي» heads the chain
«آبائه» is a relation with no name; the Prophet quoted after «قال» is the end, not a link
«صاحب الطاق» is the transmitter's sobriquet, kept as written
